news.title: Bitcoin settles near $65,000 as oil's march toward $100 fails to spook the market
news.summary: BTC held just under $65,000 and crypto broadly rose on Friday even as Brent crude surged to $97.66, its highest since May, as the Iran conflict persists and traditional markets stay muted.

news.title: A $5 billion cluster has formed in bitcoin options. It tells a bullish story
news.summary: Bitcoin's $70,000 and $72,000 call strikes on Deribit have accumulated nearly $5 billion in open interest, with calls outnumbering puts by a significant margin.

Crypto market maker B2C2 held sale talks with multiple potential buyers
news.summary: The SBI-owned crypto trading firm is said to have attracted takeover interest from a number of suitors over the past 18 months, but valuation has been a sticking point.

news.title: EU hits Russia with massive 21st sanctions package targeting $120B crypto network
news.summary: The EU is considering a ban on third-country crypto services providers for the first time and is targeting 14 crypto companies, which it has not named yet.
